jaeger_query_strategy.boundary_semantics: inclusive microsecond bounds; adjacent interval begins previous end + 1us
jaeger_query_strategy.split_policy: inclusive integer-microsecond midpoint; recursively split any result at or above limit or with total greater than returned count

loki_query_strategy.split_policy: integer nanosecond midpoint; recursively split every result reaching limit

notes: Response bodies are stored as received; no normalization, filtering, or cross-scenario equalization is applied.
Jaeger window responses are stored as immutable native chunks; inclusive-window overlap is retained in RAW and logically deduplicated downstream with source provenance.
A query reaching the trace limit is preserved as a non-model-visible control attempt and split deterministically; it is never accepted as a complete RAW chunk.
hashes.sha256 includes manifest.json and all raw response files; hashes.sha256 does not hash itself.
